description: This file defines the class 'BuzzLikeOnCommentDecorator', which acts as a decorator for the 'BuzzLikeOnComment' entity. It provides methods to set employee and comment references, and to retrieve formatted 'liked' timestamps.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnCommentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the 'BuzzLikeOnComment' entity, providing methods to associate employees and comments by ID, and to retrieve formatted timestamps of when the like occurred.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a BuzzLikeOnComment entity.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnComment
methods.description: Returns the BuzzLikeOnComment entity being decorated.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the BuzzLikeOnComment based on employee number.

methods.name: setCommentByCommentId
methods.description: Associates a BuzzComment entity with the BuzzLikeOnComment based on comment ID.

methods.name: getLikedAtDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the comment was liked, formatted as a string.

methods.name: getLikedAtTime
methods.description: Returns the time when the comment was liked, formatted as a string.
